## Enforced boundaries

These are checked by `import-linter` in CI, which makes them the only architecture claims here that cannot silently drift. Breaking one fails the build.

| boundary | source | must not import |
|---|---|---|
| kernel imports only capability ports (scaffold) | `agents.execution_engine.engine` | `app.api` |
| agents.workflows must not import the execution kernel or the web layer | `agents.workflows` | `agents.execution_engine`, `app` |
| agents.capabilities must not import the execution kernel or the web layer | `agents.capabilities` | `agents.execution_engine`, `app` |
| agents.runtime must not import the execution kernel or the web layer | `agents.runtime` | `agents.execution_engine`, `app` |
